== Course of events ==

Once upon a time, there were four little Rabbits whose names were Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter. This tale concerns the circumstances that brought these four young creatures together and set the stage for the events that would unfold. The story gathers around Peter and his three siblings, each marked by their own temperament and character. Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail were good little bunnies, while Peter, by contrast, was very naughty—a distinction that would prove consequential to the unfolding narrative.

The characters involved in this foundational event include Cotton-tail, Flopsy, Mopsy, Peter, and Rabbit, woven together into the fabric of this tale. The narrative voice, in its gentle and matter-of-fact manner, introduces these rabbits and establishes the moral undercurrent that runs through their story. By presenting the four siblings at the outset—their names, their natures, and the contrast between the obedient and the disobedient—the tale sets forth the essential framework upon which all that follows depends.
